## Plan authored — Story #9

**[Share projects with viewer/editor roles via POST /projects/:id/shares](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-epic-scope-mandrel-0d05d92d/issues/9)** — `type::story`, `agent::ready`, cohort `plan-run::dc780f04`.

**Single Story (N=1).** The work is one cohesive capability slice — schema migration, a role-resolution seam, the share endpoint, and the widened project/task handlers all serve the same access-control model, so splitting would fragment coupled logic. It stays confined to the API unit + store schema, as the task requires.

**What it specifies:**
- **Schema** — append-only migration `0002` adding `project_shares (project_id, user_id, role, created_at)` with composite PK, FKs, and a `viewer|editor` constraint. Migration 0001 untouched; schema stays in the store SSOT.
- **Endpoint** — `POST /projects/:id/shares`, owner-only. Authorization resolved before validation: **404** for no-relationship callers (privacy — existence never leaked), **403** for non-owner shared users, **400 VALIDATION_ERROR** for bad body / unknown user / bad role / self-share, **201** on success (idempotent upsert).
- **Role matrix** — owner unchanged; editor views + mutates tasks; viewer read-only (mutations → 403); strangers → 404 everywhere. `listProjects` widens to owned + shared.
- **Boundaries** — worker and admin CLI untouched; exports stay owner-scoped (recorded as a non-goal). This resolves the one genuine ambiguity in the task: "view the project and its tasks" doesn't mention exports, so they remain owner-only rather than silently widening.

**Verification:** new `test/api.shares.test.js` (contract), full `node --test`, and `npm run typecheck`.

**Notes:**
- An advisory `/deliver-light` suggestion fired at Gate #1 (small footprint) — recorded, not acted on, per `--yes` semantics; you ran the full planning route as instructed.
- Both plan critics returned `dispatch: false` (ledgered skips); text-hygiene clean.
